{
    "sla_rules": [
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_001",
            "metric": "DaysToHire",
            "threshold": 45.0,
            "threshold_operator": "<",
            "penalty_amount": 0,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 0,
            "description": "No penalty as hiring is faster than target days",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_002",
            "metric": "InterviewCompletionRatePercent",
            "threshold": 95.0,
            "threshold_operator": "<",
            "penalty_amount": 200,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 2,
            "description": "2% penalty if interview completion rate falls below 95%",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_003",
            "metric": "OfferAcceptanceRatePercent",
            "threshold": 90.0,
            "threshold_operator": "<",
            "penalty_amount": 300,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 3,
            "description": "3% penalty if offer acceptance rate falls below 90%",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_004",
            "metric": "BackgroundCheckApprovalPercent",
            "threshold": 85.0,
            "threshold_operator": "<",
            "penalty_amount": 400,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 4,
            "description": "4% penalty if background check approval rate falls below 85%",
            "applicable_period": "per incident"
        }
    ],
    "violation_conditions": [
        {
            "metric": "DaysToHire",
            "condition": "DaysToHire > TargetDaysToHire",
            "penalty_rule": "No penalty as DaysToHire exceeding TargetDaysToHire does not trigger a penalty"
        },
        {
            "metric": "InterviewCompletionRatePercent",
            "condition": "InterviewCompletionRatePercent < 95",
            "penalty_rule": "2% penalty per incident when interview completion rate falls below 95%"
        },
        {
            "metric": "OfferAcceptanceRatePercent",
            "condition": "OfferAcceptanceRatePercent < 90",
            "penalty_rule": "3% penalty per incident when offer acceptance rate falls below 90%"
        },
        {
            "metric": "BackgroundCheckApprovalPercent",
            "condition": "BackgroundCheckApprovalPercent < 85",
            "penalty_rule": "4% penalty per incident when background check approval rate falls below 85%"
        }
    ],
    "sql_query": "SELECT IncidentID, CASE WHEN InterviewCompletionRatePercent < 95 THEN 200 WHEN OfferAcceptanceRatePercent < 90 THEN 300 WHEN BackgroundCheckApprovalPercent < 85 THEN 400 ELSE 0 END AS penalty_monetary FROM incidents_teacher_hiring",
    "data_fields_required": ["IncidentID", "DaysToHire", "TargetDaysToHire", "InterviewCompletionRatePercent", "OfferAcceptanceRatePercent", "BackgroundCheckApprovalPercent"],
    "monthly_service_fee": 10000,
    "max_monthly_penalty_percentage": 30
}
